visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men sit on a grey sofa against a plain white wall. The man on the left wears a green button-up shirt and has longish dark hair, expressing excitement with wide eyes and an open mouth. The man on the right wears a grey jacket and a black baseball cap, smiling calmly. They both hold white rectangular boxes with blue circular logos and 'WHY SO DELICIOUS' text. Large red and yellow Chinese captions appear at the bottom. (2) The scene cuts between medium shots of the two men and individual close-ups. The man in the grey jacket speaks directly to the camera, tilting his head slightly, while holding his box steady. The background shows a white lamp and a light-colored wall. (3) The man in the green shirt reacts dramatically, touching his face with his hand and looking puzzled with a furrowed brow. The man in the grey cap continues to explain, gesturing with his hands. More boxes are visible on a low table in front of them, suggesting a commercial or inventory setting. (4) An inset circle appears near the bottom left featuring a third man with glasses speaking. The man in green then takes center stage, holding his box closer to the lens and pointing upwards emphatically. Vibrant, colorful text overlays flash across the screen. (5) In a comedic conclusion, the man in the green shirt falls backward onto the sofa cushions, his legs kicking up into the air in an exaggerated tumble. The man in the grey cap watches him, smiling. The final frame is a white background with a black-and-white illustration of a baker and informative text about a sale deadline.

(6) [Subtitle]: 但是 也許 未來節慶的時候 會推出一下禮盒吧. (7) [Subtitle]: 蛤 為什麼. (8) [Subtitle]: 就是因為我們的興趣和擅長的 還是做影片. (9) [Subtitle]: 所以我們今年就決定把人力 全部集中在做影片. (10) [Subtitle]: 希望可以帶給大家 更多有趣的內容. (11) [Subtitle]: 現在想吃餅乾的人怎麼辦?. (12) [Subtitle]: 別擔心現在有最後一舞特別優惠. [Slogan]: 全館九折. [Slogan]: 即日起至3/10止. [Slogan]: 你只要滿NT800. [Slogan]: 超取免運. (13) [Subtitle]: 重點是 前兩百名下單 還送你神秘小禮物喔. (14) [Subtitle]: 拿麼好吃的 最後一舞. (15) [Logo]: 拿麼好吃 WHY SO DELICIOUS. [Slogan]: 即日起到3/10號為止. [Slogan]: 把握機會. [Slogan]: 機會不再.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice shouts an announcement with high arousal and a sharp pitch contour. Upbeat, moderate-tempo electronic pop music plays in the background, featuring a steady synth beat. There is minimal ambient noise, indicating a quiet indoor recording. (2) A second male voice enters with a calmer, more narrative tone, explaining the business change. His speech rate is moderate, and his articulation is clear. The background music maintains a constant volume level, providing a cheerful atmosphere without masking the vocals. (3) The first male voice interrupts with an exaggerated, comedic tone. The acoustic environment remains dry with little reverb. Brief sounds of fabric rustling are heard as the men move on the furniture. (4) The first speaker delivers a rapid-fire promotional list with high intensity and energy. Short, bright post-production sound effects coincide with the visual cues. His voice is loud and projected, conveying excitement for the 'Final Dance' sale. (5) Sounds of laughter and a dull thud follow as someone moves abruptly. The background music swells slightly before ending with a short, simple musical jingle accompanying the final visual information.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a strategic announcement for the cookie brand 'WHY SO DELICIOUS' (拿麼好吃). The creators announce they are shifting their business model from permanent sales to limited holiday-only releases so they can focus on content creation. To mark this transition, they promote a final sale event ('Final Dance') with discounts and gifts, using a high-energy, comedic style to maintain audience engagement.
